title.id: Zenith 2.0 (12 Nov sore): cocok dengan data game terbaru (1.10.1.2)
title.en: Zenith 2.0 (Nov 12, evening): matches the latest game data (1.10.1.2)

id: Game update lagi (data 1.10.1.2): data terjemahan disesuaikan. Setelah game di-update sampai lobi, tekan Suntik Data. Tidak perlu Pulihkan Data.
Teks baru diterjemahkan: "Main Tim Tanpa Turun Poin".
Semua isi update 12 Nov pagi tetap ada: 173 teks baru, istilah "Kontestan", dan tombol lobi "MULAI GAME".
Masih Mandarin: badge faksi di pop-up kartu, gambar nama kontestan di judul Lineup, dan tugas mingguan Battle Pass.
en: Game updated again (data 1.10.1.2): translation data matched to it. After updating the game to the lobby, press Inject Data. No need to Restore Data.
New text translated: "No Rank Loss in Team Play".
Everything from the Nov 12 morning update is kept: 173 new texts and the lobby "MULAI GAME" button.
Still in Chinese: faction badges in card pop-ups, chessplayer name images in Lineup titles, and Battle Pass weekly tasks.
